Name: Dial Countdown
Author: Mate Wish Key

Actions.Name: Countdown
Actions.Tooltip: A countdown timer on a dial. Press the dial to start or pause; turn it to adjust by seconds, or push it in and turn to adjust by minutes. Tap the screen to pause or resume, tap twice to reset it to full, hold for the next preset.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust the clock — push in for minutes
TriggerDescription.LongTouch: Put the clock right, then next preset

Actions.Name: Countdown (Key)
Actions.Tooltip: The same countdown timer on an ordinary key. Press to pause or resume, press twice to reset it to full, hold to load the next preset.

Description: Countdown timers for the Stream Deck + dials and for ordinary keys. Tap to pause or resume, tap twice to reset, hold for the next preset — and on a dial, press to start or pause, turn to adjust by seconds, or push the dial in and turn to adjust by minutes.
